description: Tell My Noticeboard where local community activity is announced: the address of a group’s own website, a parish, library or venue programme, or an iCal feed. We read the page ourselves; nothing is published on your word. Community-led and voluntary activity only. Needs an API key. Returns a receipt; repeat a call with the same idempotency_key to get the same receipt.

about.description: Who publishes it or what it covers, e.g. "Bridport Library events".

idempotency_key.description: Any string you choose; a retry with the same key returns the first receipt.

note.description: Anything that helps a curator, e.g. "lists the community choir’s rehearsals".

url.description: The page or feed address, starting https://

name: suggest_source
title: Suggest a page or feed to read
